mapper.select: SELECT CLDR.사업장 AS CLDR_BPLC , CLDR.일자 AS CLDR_DEDT , CLDR.주차 AS CLDR_WEEK , CLDR.공휴유무 AS CLDR_HLDYENNC , CLDR.공휴사유 AS CLDR_HLDYPRVONSH FROM 달력 CLDR WHERE CLDR.사업장 = '20' AND CLDR.일자 > CONVERT(VARCHAR , GETDATE(),112) AND RTRIM(CLDR.공휴유무) <> '' AND ( LEFT(CLDR.공휴사유,2) <> '토요' AND LEFT(CLDR.공휴사유,2) <> '일 ')

SELECT DBO.웹_재고중량_함수(#{W_DEDT}, #{IC_CODE}, #{INQIRE_SE}, #{W_DE}, #{W_SN}) AS INVNTRY_WT , (CASE IC.포장단위 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.포장단위 END) AS IC_PACKNGUNIT
, (CASE IC.단위당수량 WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE IC.단위당수량 END) AS IC_UNITQY FROM 품목코드 IC WHERE 1=1 AND IC.사업장 = #{W_UNIT_BPLC} AND IC.품목코드 = #{IC_CODE}
SELECT 일련번호 AS SN , 메뉴구분 AS MENU_SE , 메뉴공지A사용 AS A_USE_AT , 메뉴공지A AS MENU_A , 메뉴공지B사용 AS B_USE_AT , 메뉴공지B AS MENU_B FROM 웹메뉴공지 WHERE 메뉴구분 = #{menuSe}
